subject: [PATCH v4 08/14] SUNRPC: stop the svc_unregister() sweep once rpcbind stops answering

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_unregister() function to stop sweeping for stale rpcbind entries once it receives no answer from rpcbind. This is done to prevent unnecessary timeouts and improve performance when a local rpcbind never replies. The change affects how nfsd services handle listener setup and cleanup, reducing the number of timeouts incurred due to non-responsive rpcbind servers.
